description: Add fiat deposit/withdrawal tracking to exchange CSV importers so the ledger captures cash flowing in and out of exchanges, not just BTC transactions
principles: Default-on - fiat deposits/withdrawals captured without a CLI flag
Stablecoins are fiat - USDC, GUSD, BUSD treated as fiat-equivalent
Trade filter unchanged - trades still require BTC on at least one side
No database changes - import_transactions() already accepts any currency
Backward compatible - existing BTC imports produce identical results

userStories.title: Coinbase Pro importer class
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/python/imports/exchanges/coinbase_pro.py with CoinbaseProImporter class
Inherit from BaseImporter with @register decorator
Set name='CoinbasePro', source_type='exchange'
Columns: portfolio, type, time, amount, balance, amount/balance unit, transfer id, trade id, order id
Detection heuristic: 'portfolio' + 'trade id' + 'amount/balance unit' columns
Trade parsing: group 'match' rows by trade_id, pair buy/sell legs (positive=buy, negative=sell)
Fee parsing: 'fee' rows grouped by trade_id, add to corresponding trade
Only import trades where BTC is on one side (filter LTC/USD, LINK/USD etc.)
Deposit parsing: type='deposit', currency from 'amount/balance unit'
- BTC deposits: Deposit(buy_curr='BTC')
- USD deposits: Deposit(buy_curr='USD') — fiat tracked via is_fiat()
- Altcoin deposits: filtered out (not BTC, not fiat)
Withdrawal parsing: type='withdrawal', currency from 'amount/balance unit'
- BTC withdrawals: Withdrawal(sell_curr='BTC') with --withdraw-to support
- USD withdrawals: Withdrawal(sell_curr='USD')
- Altcoin withdrawals: filtered out
Create tests/fixtures/csv_samples/coinbase_pro_sample.csv from real export data
Unit tests: detection, trade pairing, fee aggregation, BTC filter, fiat deposits/withdrawals, registration
Existing CoinbaseImporter (standard format) completely unchanged
